limitations: Capture partial at 189/240; no extrapolation to unseen cycles.
Only one simulated position, no human-labeled Brooks benchmark and no counterfactual; cannot estimate edge.
No provider token usage, reliable finish metadata, or hidden reasoning; character count does not prove truncation.

Trader receives 120 raw H1 and 120 raw M15 bars; HTF is compressed context unless conditional raw refresh occurs. Hourly cadence is slower than M15, a sampling limitation rather than proof of missed trades.
Low reference use is descriptive because reads are conditional and runtime already contains the procedure.
Separate model-output, host-contract, adapter, production-runner and replay-harness findings; do not assign harness-only root-path issue to production.
No specific model capability or causal attribution.
